messages:
alex_support: FYI customer (nora_acme) opened a support ticket — embeddings endpoint started returning a flurry of 429s ~09:11 UTC and their vectors/sec collapsed while tokens/sec stayed ~normal. They see latency spikes too. Repro steps included below.

sara_cs: What changed on our side? Any rollout in the last 24h for batching or kv-cache?

maya_ml: We had a small batching-window rollout yesterday evening (autosplit tuning). Looking at infra metrics now — notable: GPU queue depth for pool-g4-2 shot up at 09:10, concurrent in-flight tokens steady but vector completion rate dropped.

liam_runtime: Seeing a KV cache miss storm and lots of auth 429s from token-introspect service. Snippet from runtime logs around the spike: 
```
[2026-02-12T09:10:57Z] kvcache: miss_rate=0.87 window_ms=1200 queue_depth=134
[2026-02-12T09:11:01Z] auth-introspect: 429 quota=exceeded scope=token-latency host=auth-prod
[2026-02-12T09:11:03Z] rpc: enqueue_latency_ms=4500 gpu_queue_depth=128 shards_active=8
[2026-02-12T09:11:07Z] worker: batch_size=64 tokens=1024 vectors=64 completed=8 error=429
```

ops_bot: :warning: alert: high queue depth on pool-g4-2 (queue_depth>120) — started 2026-02-12T09:10:55Z.

maya_ml: Hypothesis: the batching-window change increased tail batch sizes for many requests -> higher KV cache churn (misses) -> extra RPCs to model backend and token-introspect -> auth service rate-limits -> clients retry -> amplification -> GPU queue saturation -> vectors/sec drop.

alex_support: Customer provided a minimal repro (single curl) that demonstrates vector rate drop. They send parallel requests for embeddings and see 429s after ~20s: 
```bash
for i in $(seq 1 100); do \
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.company/v1/embeddings \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}" \
    -d '{"model":"open-embed-3","input":["short doc"]}' &\
done; wait
```

liam_runtime: Quick measurements: when we force smaller max_batch_size (<=16) on a replica, the 429s and queue depth come down and vectors/sec recovers. Suggest temporary rollback of the batching-window rollout or enforce a soft cap on batch size for that pool.

maya_ml: Also noticed dimension validation errors bubbling for a small fraction of requests (client accidentally sending 1537-d vectors once) — that forces fallback paths and extra processing. Not primary, but increases load.

alex_support: Action items: 1) rollback batching-window change for pool-g4-2 (liam) 2) add short-term rate-limiter on client-side retries (ops) 3) ask auth team to check token-introspect QPS and increase quota temporarily (sara) 4) reach back to customer with repro steps + ask for any client-side batching.

nora_acme: thanks — we do have a quick retry loop in our SDK (exponential) but it kicks in aggressively on 429. We'll disable it while you dig.

liam_runtime: Rolling rollback now on pool-g4-2 -> setting max_batch_window back to previous value, and forcing batch_size cap=16 for the pool. Patching in-flight config; monitoring.

ops_bot: deploy-bot: change applied to pool-g4-2 (rollback batching-window) — deploy id d-20260212-09:16.

maya_ml: Early telemetry looks good: queue depth dropping to ~20, kvcache miss_rate slowly recovering, vectors/sec climbing back toward baseline. Will monitor 30m.

alex_support: I'll update the customer and keep this thread open until stable. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
